inputs.text: The whole US-Israel-Iran situation is clearly staged by the real powers behind the scenes. The US is floating this 15-point ceasefire plan through Pakistan as a supposed sincere offer, but it's obvious bait to keep the pressure on. Iran responds with their five conditions for stopping the aggression, getting compensation, and securing sovereignty over the Strait of Hormuz, yet the elites are already twisting it to make Iran look unreasonable. Israel isn't even bothering to hide their skepticism and push for pre-emptive strike rights, which proves the entire narrative is coordinated to justify whatever escalation the hidden hands want next. None of this is about ending conflict—it's pure manipulation from the top to control the region and the story.
